scope: All 1635 canonical records plus inventory of the five staged Q1636-Q1640 candidates

manually_compared_pairs.reason: Same menstrual blood loss, pica, iron studies, diagnostic task and iron-deficiency key.
Same postdiarrheal ascending areflexic weakness and Guillain-Barre diagnosis.
Both ask for CCK after a fatty meal with gallbladder contraction; extra secretory findings do not change the task.
Same RYR2 exercise-triggered bidirectional ventricular tachycardia and diastolic SR calcium release mechanism.
Same B12-pattern megaloblastic anemia plus neurologic findings and elevated methylmalonic acid task.
Virtually same ocular fatigability vignette and postsynaptic nicotinic ACh-receptor target.
Sensitivity in reference-positive patients versus specificity in reference-negative patients. Independently calculated 90/100=90% and 170/200=85%; these are different constructs.
Corneal clouding versus its absence distinguishes MPS I/alpha-L-iduronidase from MPS II/iduronate-2-sulfatase; distinct keyed enzymes.
Same lateral-medullary syndrome context, but diagnosis versus nucleus-ambiguus localization. Shared stem remains a reuse concern for test assembly.
Metaphyseal sunburst osteosarcoma versus diaphyseal onion-skin Ewing sarcoma; distinct diagnoses.
Both ask how primary aldosterone excess increases ENaC-mediated potassium secretion.
Both ask for the neonatal LA-over-RA pressure change closing the foramen ovale.
Same 20%-to-10% trial and NNT calculation. Independently calculated 1/(0.20-0.10)=10.
Same BSND renal salt wasting/deafness phenotype and barttin-dependent ClC-Ka/Kb mechanism.
Same SLC12A1 Bartter phenotype and NKCC2 transporter-identification task.
Same concizumab plasma assay, TFPI reduction, FXa/thrombin increase and TFPI-antagonism key.
Same acidic duodenal chyme, bicarbonate response and secretin identification.
Same progressive amnestic dementia and extracellular amyloid/intracellular tau pathology task.

pair_review_limit: Only the 17 lexical candidates plus one exact-construct pair were manually compared. This is not exhaustive semantic comparison of all pairs and does not certify clinical correctness.
source_metadata_note: Missing hashes document absent frozen evidence, not false medicine. Government hosting does not establish government authorship. Old review labels do not establish a current independent re-audit.
